claims.claim: NVIDIA DGX Spark with 64 GB of unified memory is coming this month from Acer, ASUS, Dell, Gigabyte, HP and MSI, with DGX OS and the NVIDIA AI software stack ready from day one.
claims.episode_span: NVIDIA says DGX Spark with 64 GB of unified memory is coming this month from Acer, ASUS, Dell, Gigabyte, HP and MSI
claims.source_title: (PR) NVIDIA Launches DGX Spark 64 GB Desktop AI Systems
claims.supporting_quote: Coming this month, NVIDIA DGX Spark will be available with 64 GB of unified memory from top manufacturer partners—Acer, ASUS, Dell, Gigabyte, HP and MSI—giving developers, researchers and AI enthusiasts a new configuration with DGX OS and the NVIDIA AI software stack ready to use from day one.

claims.claim: Gigabyte’s 64 GB AI TOP ATOM, on the NVIDIA DGX Spark platform and the same hardware design as the 128 GB version, is available starting October 23.
claims.episode_span: Gigabyte’s AI TOP ATOM 64 GB version, on the same DGX Spark hardware design as its existing 128 GB offering, is available starting October 23.
claims.source_title: (PR) Gigabyte AI TOP ATOM 64GB Unified Memory Version Expands Possibilities for Desktop AI Development
claims.supporting_quote: Available starting October 23, the new configuration retains the hardware design of AI TOP ATOM, based on the NVIDIA DGX Spark platform

claims.claim: MSI’s EdgeXpert 64 GB, based on NVIDIA DGX Spark, is specified at 1 petaFLOP of FP4 AI compute and is described as running up to 100 billion parameter models inside the firewall.
claims.episode_span: MSI’s EdgeXpert 64 GB, also on that platform, is specified at 1 petaFLOP of FP4 AI compute
claims.source_title: (PR) MSI Extends EdgeXpert Lineup With 64 GB Model
claims.supporting_quote: Based on the NVIDIA DGX Spark platform (1 petaFLOP FP4 AI compute), the MSI EdgeXpert 64 GB model runs up to 100B parameter open-source models entirely inside the firewall

claims.claim: NVIDIA Sync helps teams set up a cluster of connected systems and monitor CPU and GPU activity from one desktop app.
claims.episode_span: NVIDIA Sync is the desktop app for setting up a cluster of connected systems and watching CPU and GPU activity from one place.
claims.source_title: (PR) MSI Extends EdgeXpert Lineup With 64 GB Model
claims.supporting_quote: NVIDIA Sync helps teams set up a cluster of connected systems and monitor CPU and GPU activity from one desktop app.

claims.claim: Northrop Grumman rebranded its Super Lattice Castellated Field Effect Transistor as FORTITUDE, a grain-of-rice-sized gallium nitride chip it says delivers three times more power and 20 times better signal quality.
claims.episode_span: Northrop Grumman has rebranded its Super Lattice Castellated Field Effect Transistor as FORTITUDE
claims.source_title: Northrop Grumman Rebrands Wideband GaN Technology as FORTITUDE, Targets RF System Integration
claims.supporting_quote: Previously known as the Super Lattice Castellated Field Effect Transistor , FORTITUDE™ builds on the company’s focused research and development and substantial investment in microelectronics

claims.claim: Researchers at Paderborn University, the University of Basel and Ruhr University Bochum reported in Physical Review Letters that semiconductor quantum dots in an optical resonator can generate almost perfectly identical photons via biexciton decay.
claims.episode_span: Researchers at Paderborn University, the University of Basel and Ruhr University Bochum report in Physical Review Letters
claims.source_title: Semiconductor Quantum-Dot Resonator Improves Single-Photon Quality for Quantum Systems
claims.supporting_quote: Working in close collaboration, researchers from Paderborn University, the University of Basel and Ruhr University Bochum have made a significant breakthrough in the field of quantum communication.

claims.claim: Wccftech reports that NVIDIA’s Ian Buck says CoreWeave’s V100 GPUs still run nearly a decade later, and that Vera Rubin NVL72 is going live with a 4.8x token-generation speedup.
claims.episode_span: Wccftech reports that NVIDIA’s Ian Buck says CoreWeave’s V100 GPUs are still running nearly a decade later
claims.source_title: NVIDIA’s Ian Buck Says CoreWeave’s V100 GPUs Still Run Nearly A Decade Later, Even As Vera Rubin NVL72 Goes Live With a 4.8x Token Generation Speedup
claims.supporting_quote: NVIDIA’s Ian Buck Says CoreWeave’s V100 GPUs Still Run Nearly A Decade Later, Even As Vera Rubin NVL72 Goes Live With a 4.8x Token Generation Speedup

claims.claim: Intro Group is to invest $270 million in Egypt’s Kemet Data Center, developed in two phases.
claims.episode_span: Intro Group is to invest $270 million in Egypt’s Kemet Data Center, and the facility is to be developed in two phases.
claims.source_title: Intro Group to invest $270m in Egypt’s Kemet Data Center
claims.supporting_quote: Intro Group to invest $270m in Egypt’s Kemet Data Center

claims.episode_span: Poland’s National Data Processing Center network has received PLN 1.56 billion ($401 million)
claims.source_title: Poland’s National Data Processing Center receives EU funding grant
claims.supporting_quote: The data center network has received PLN 1.56 billion ($401m) from the European Funds for Digital Development program

claims.claim: A Dline.ua data center in Kyiv was taken offline by Russian strikes, after strikes on other data centers in the city.
claims.episode_span: A Dline.ua data center in Kyiv has been taken offline by Russian strikes
claims.source_title: Another data center in Kyiv taken offline by Russian strikes
claims.supporting_quote: Dline.ua facility taken down, follows strikes on numerous others data centers in the city

claims.claim: SK Hynix said it is reviewing financing alternatives for Solidigm and has made no decision.
claims.episode_span: SK Hynix said on Thursday it is reviewing financing alternatives for U.S. subsidiary Solidigm and has reached no decision
claims.source_title: SK Hynix Weighs Solidigm Funding Options as HBM Reshapes DRAM Capacity
claims.supporting_quote: The Korean chipmaker said on Thursday that no decision has been reached, and that any funding move would be judged on how it affects existing shareholders and the long-term value of the group as a whole.

claims.claim: Reuters reported on September 25 that Solidigm was contemplating a U.S. IPO as early as 2027 that could value the unit at up to $150 billion and raise as much as $15 billion, with plans described as tentative.
claims.episode_span: A Reuters report on September 25 said Solidigm was contemplating a U.S. IPO as early as 2027
claims.source_title: SK Hynix Weighs Solidigm Funding Options as HBM Reshapes DRAM Capacity
claims.supporting_quote: The caution follows a Reuters report on September 25 that Solidigm is already contemplating a U.S. initial public offering as early as 2027.

claims.claim: SK Hynix told the SEC it is evaluating additional production sites, has no verdict on a possible plant in Japan, and pledged to disclose specifics if a decision is confirmed or within three months.
claims.episode_span: In an SEC filing the company said it is evaluating additional production sites, with no verdict on reports of a plant in Japan
claims.source_title: SK Hynix Weighs Solidigm Funding Options as HBM Reshapes DRAM Capacity
claims.supporting_quote: It pledged to disclose specifics if a decision is confirmed, or within three months.

claims.claim: Reuters reported on September 16 that SK Hynix was in talks with Intel about U.S. memory manufacturing, including leasing part of an Ohio facility or a joint venture, and SK Hynix said no agreements were finalized.
claims.episode_span: Reuters reported on September 16 talks with Intel on U.S. memory manufacturing
claims.source_title: SK Hynix Weighs Solidigm Funding Options as HBM Reshapes DRAM Capacity
claims.supporting_quote: SK Hynix made clear that no agreements on that front have been finalized.

claims.claim: EMD Electronics opened a 38,000-square-foot R&D facility in Sheboygan Falls, Wisconsin, for synthesis, scale-up and technology transfer, with WEDC collaborating.
claims.episode_span: EMD Electronics, the North America electronics business of Merck KGaA, Darmstadt, Germany, has opened a 38,000-square-foot research and development facility
claims.source_title: EMD Electronics Opens New R&D Facility in Wisconsin
claims.supporting_quote: EMD Electronics, the North America electronics business of Merck KGaA, Darmstadt, Germany, today announced the opening of a new 38,000-square-foot research and development facility at its Sheboygan Falls, Wisconsin site

claims.claim: Micron’s post lists fabs in Idaho and New York, a modernized Virginia plant, Singapore packaging investment, a Japan cleanroom, Taiwan operations and India’s first assembly and test site in Sanand, plus more than $250 billion of U.S. manufacturing and R&D investment expected to create over 90,000 jobs.
claims.episode_span: In the United States alone, the post says this includes more than $250 billion in manufacturing and R&D investment expected to create over 90,000 jobs.
claims.source_title: Micron Expands Global Manufacturing for AI and Semiconductors
claims.supporting_quote: In the United States alone, this includes more than $250 billion in manufacturing and R&D investments expected to create over 90,000 jobs

claims.claim: An unreleased Ryzen 9 5900X3D engineering sample, code 100-000000652, reports 128 MB of L3 split 96 MB and 32 MB, about 4.7 GHz at 105 W, versus a dual-stack prototype at 192 MB and 4.4 GHz boost.
claims.episode_span: An engineering sample of the never-released Ryzen 9 5900X3D, code 100-000000652, reports 128 MB of L3
claims.source_title: Unreleased AMD Ryzen 9 5900X3D Engineering Sample Appears With 128 MB L3 Cache
claims.supporting_quote: The 12-core, 24-thread Zen 3 chip carries the code 100-000000652 and reports 128 MB of L3 cache, split as 96 MB on one CCD and 32 MB on the other.
